No specific $/kW or $/MWh figure found stated by name by an X-energy leader either (S-1 and earnings call discuss capex/revenue/TAM in aggregate, not a per-unit price); Dow's Seadrift pricing/structure for process heat is described only in aggregate deal-structure terms (ARDP 50/50 cost share) in the S-1, never as a specific $/lb-steam or $/MWh figure by any named speaker.

Could not independently verify (via a company-controlled or trade-press source, i.e. not a data-aggregator site) a current X-energy executive whose background is specifically at DOE (as an employee, not just via the ARDP program relationship) or at Westinghouse. A University of Michigan bio page names a 'Jeff Harper, VP Strategy and Business Development' with a Westinghouse Advanced Reactors Program background, but he does not appear on x-energy.com/leadership as of this pass, so he was excluded rather than guessed at.

Could not find deep (2-3 sentence, prior-employer-level) background for four Kairos Power senior staff (Kerry McIntosh, Tom Miller, Esther Klisura, Jaclyn Rodriguez) beyond their name and title on kairospower.com/company; the only additional detail (Esther Klisura ex-Calpine senior counsel; Kerry McIntosh holds a PhD from University of Newcastle) came from data-aggregator sites (ZoomInfo/LinkedIn search snippets), not a 'good source' per the contract, so it was omitted rather than cited as fetched fact.

No earnings-call or press quote found where an X-energy or Kairos leader explicitly states where the company will NOT compete (the S-1's 'we do not construct, own, or operate power plants' business-model disclaimer is corporate prose, unattributed to a named speaker, so it was not usable as a quote).
